€10U. (स्नेटयति-ते) 
__1 To go. 
__2 To love, be in love.

€4P. (स्निह्यति, स्निग्ध) 
__1 To feel or have affection for, love, be fond of (with loc. of the person or thing that is loved or liked); किं नु खलु बालेऽस्मिन्नौरस इव पुत्रे स्निह्यति मे मनः [[Ś. 7]]; स च स्निह्यत्यावयोः [[

]] (where आवयोः may be genitive also). 
__2 To be easily attached. 
__3 To be pleased with, be kind to. 
__4 To be sticky, viscid, or adhesive. 
__5 To be smooth or bland. -Caus. (स्नेहयति-ते) 
__1 To make unctuous, anoint, besmear, lubricate. 
__2 To cause to love. 
__3 To dissolve, destroy, kill.

a. [स्निह्-क्त] 
__1 Loving, affectionate, friendly, attached, tender; नादस्ताबद्विकलकुररीकूजितस्निग्धतारः [[

.]] 
__2 Oily, unctuous, greasy, wetted with oil; उत्पश्यामि त्वयि तटगते स्निग्धभिन्नाञ्जनाभे [[

.]] 
__3 Sticky, viscid, adhesive, cohesive. 
__4 Glistening, shining, glassy, resplendent; कनकनिकषस्निग्धा बिद्युत् प्रिया न ममोर्वशी [[

]]; 6. 21. 
__5 Smooth, emollient. 
__6 Moist, wet. 
__7 Cooling. 
__8 Kind, soft, bland, amiable; प्रीतिस्निग्धैर्जनपदवधूलोचनैः पीयमानः [[

]]; 3. 22. 
__10 Thick, dense, compact; स्निग्धच्छायातरुषु वसतिं रामगिर्याश्रमेषु (चक्रे) [[

.]] 
__11 Intent, fixed, steadfast (as a gaze or look). 
-ग्धः 
__1 A friend, a affectionate or friendly person; विज्ञैः स्निग्धैरुपकृतमपि द्वेष्यतामेति कैश्चित् [[

.]] 
__2 The red castor-oil plant. 
__3 A kind of pine. 
-ग्धम् 
__1 Oil. 
__2 Bee's-wax. 
__3 Light, lustre. 
__4 Thickness, coarseness. 
__5 Civet. 
-Comp. 
-जनः an affectionate or friendly person, a friend; स्निग्धजनसंविभक्तं हि दुःखं सह्यवेदनं भवति [[Ś. 3.]] 
-तण्डुलः a kind of rice of quick growth. 
-दृष्टि a. looking intently or with a fixed gaze. [Page1726-2] 
-पत्रः, -त्रा the jujube. 
-फला the ichneumon plant (Mar. मुंगूसवेल). 
-राजिः a kind of snake.
